story:
It was a sunny day at Oakdale Elementary School. The swings were creaking in the breeze, and the playground was buzzing with kids playing tag. Soomin, a happy five-year-old, was sitting on a bench, trying to open his brand-new lunchbox. But when he lifted it up, oh no! It wasn't there!

Soomin looked around frantically. "Where is my lunchbox?" he asked Mrs. Thompson, the kind teacher who always had a smile on her face. She frowned and said, "Let's ask your friends if they've seen it."

Soomin's best friend, Emma, came running over with her big brother Max, who was holding a tray of yummy sandwiches. "Hey, guys! I just saw Benny the hamster playing with something shiny near his cage," said Emma.

The three friends rushed to Benny's cage and peeked inside. And then, they heard a tiny voice squeaking, "Squeak, squeak!" It was Benny, holding Soomin's lunchbox in his paws!

But how did it get there? Soomin thought for a moment. "I think I might have left it on the table when we were playing outside," he said.

Max suggested they ask the classmate who sat at that table. They went to find him and soon found out that little Tom had picked up the lunchbox thinking it was trash, but then Benny got curious and took it for a spin!

With teamwork and kindness, Soomin's friends helped him solve the mystery of the missing lunchbox. Mrs. Thompson joined in with a big smile, "I'm so proud of all of you! You showed that even when we make mistakes, our friends can help us out."

As they sat down to eat together, Emma said, "Hey, let's have a picnic on the playground!" Max suggested they make some extra sandwiches for Benny too. Soomin grinned and said, "That's the best lunch ever!"
